## Documentation and UI
- [ ] README and affected UA/EN/RU variants are current.
- [ ] Future host tooling follows `docs/gui/GUI_DESIGN_STANDARD.md`.
- [ ] Proposal/mockups are labelled; no support claim without evidence.
- [ ] CPU model/stepping, board revision, memory map, toolchain and ABI are explicit.

## Verification
- [ ] Documentation/schema checks pass.
- [ ] Host checks, cross-build, emulator and hardware evidence are separated.
- [ ] Changed code meets 80% coverage where configured or exception justified.
- [ ] No extrapolation of Elbrus/E2K behavior from ARM/x86/RISC-V.
- [ ] Compatibility and licensing implications reviewed.

## Review policy
- Branches: `feature/<ticket>-<slug>`, `fix/<slug>`, `docs/<slug>`.
- No direct commits to protected default/release branches.
- Merge requires two independent approvals and all required CI checks, enforced with branch protection.
- [ ] Two independent approvals.
- [ ] Required checks all green.

## Українська / Русский
- [ ] Архітектурну пропозицію не подано як перевірену target-підтримку.
- [ ] Документація та локалізації актуальні.
- [ ] Два незалежні схвалення та успішний CI перед злиттям.
